name: Pickled red onion (achari-style, mustard omitted)
status: PRELIMINARY ESTIMATE — NOT COOKED OR TASTED
shelf_life_note: 7 days at ≤ 5 °C (ASSUMPTION: acidic pickle; confirm pH with a professional)
method: Dissolve sugar and salt in warm water; add vinegar and lime juice.
Pour over sliced onion; press to submerge; rest at least 1 hour.
Hold refrigerated; flavour peaks after about a day.

sauce_spec.use: acid and freshness against fried or rich food

food_safety: Hold at or below 5 °C; keep submerged; date-mark.
evidence: docs: mustard seed OMITTED from the v1.0 baseline so that mustard stays out of the declared allergens (a later test variable)
estimates_label: All quantities, yields and shelf-life values are preliminary estimates until tested by a person in a kitchen.
